issues.explanation: Vanessa said in Ep3 she was engaged to Adrian for two years, but in Ep5 she says she gave him four years of her life, so the duration of their relationship differs.
issues.suggested_fix: Change Vanessa's Ep5 line to 'I gave that man two years of my life', or clarify that they dated two years before the engagement.
